name: orb_15min_filtered_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: NIFTY's first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars at 5s) is the overnight information absorption window — gap resolution, pre-open auction clearing, and large institutional limit book repricing all happen here. When VIX sits in the 13-20 Goldilocks zone, NIFTY's opening range is meaningful: below 13, ranges are too compressed and breakouts whipsaw as market makers trivially fade them; above 20, institutional flow is erratic and gap risk dominates. When price closes outside the 15-min range for two consecutive 5s bars and aligns with session VWAP, it signals that VWAP-benchmarked programs and CTA momentum algos have begun aggressively entering in the breakout direction — their flow sustains the move for 30-90 seconds before the first mean-reversion attempt.

indicators.name: orb_high_15
indicators.formula: max(high) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570) per day
indicators.purpose: FIXED TIME WINDOW — 15 minutes = 180 bars at 5s regardless of bar size. The 09:15-09:30 window is fixed by market structure (pre-open auction + opening 15 min), not a rolling lookback. No scaling applied.

indicators.name: orb_low_15
indicators.formula: min(low) for bars where time_minutes in [555, 570) per day
indicators.purpose: Same as orb_high_15 — fixed-window floor of the range. Together they define the breakout thresholds.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume) from session open per day
indicators.purpose: CUMULATIVE measure — no lookback scaling needed. VWAP alignment confirms institutional direction: VWAP-benchmarked flows will only enter longs above VWAP, so requiring price > VWAP for CE entries filters out counter-trend breakout attempts.

indicators.name: vix_at_930
indicators.formula: India VIX close at 09:30 IST per day (forward-filled for day)
indicators.purpose: Day-level filter, not a rolling indicator. Captured at 09:30 when range forms. Below 13: NIFTY range too tight, market makers fade breakouts instantly. Above 20: institutional flow is gap-driven and erratic. The 13-20 band identifies sessions where ORB breakouts have meaningful follow-through.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars = 1 minute rolling baseline volume. At 5s resolution, 1-minute context (not 20-bar at 1-min = 20 min) is appropriate — we need to detect volume surges relative to the CURRENT regime, not the broader session trend. Breakout bars should have >1.2x normal volume to confirm genuine demand/supply.

conditions: close > orb_high_15 (price exits upper bound of 15-min range)
Previous bar also had close > orb_high_15 (2-bar persistence, 10s confirmation)
close > vwap (VWAP alignment — confirms institutional buy-side direction)
vol_ratio_12 > 1.2 (breakout bar volume surge above 1-minute baseline)
time_minutes between 570 and 630 (09:30-10:30 IST, first hour post-range)
buy_ce.confirmation: 2 consecutive 5s closes above orb_high_15 (10 seconds) to filter 5s noise spikes

conditions: close < orb_low_15 (price exits lower bound of 15-min range)
Previous bar also had close < orb_low_15 (2-bar persistence)
close < vwap (VWAP alignment — confirms institutional sell-side direction)

exit.stop_rationale: NIFTY ORB breakouts that fail typically retrace 8-10 spot points back inside the range within 30 seconds — at delta ~0.5, this is 4-5 option points. A 4-point stop catches the inflection before a full range retracement develops, consistent with typical 30s NIFTY moves of 2-5 option pts.
exit.target_rationale: VIX-filtered NIFTY ORB breakouts (where the range is neither too tight nor too volatile) extend 14-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds of institutional flow absorption. 7 option pts at delta ~0.5 captures the lower bound of this first leg, giving a 1:1.75 R:R with a 4-pt stop.

filters.vix_filter: CORE: India VIX at 09:30 must be between 13 and 20; outside this range no trades for the day
filters.time_filter: Entry only 09:30-10:30 IST (570-630 min); ORB breakouts beyond first hour have much lower follow-through
filters.trend_filter: close must be above VWAP for CE, below VWAP for PE (VWAP alignment)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — ORB on the index is well-known, but VIX filtering + 5s 2-bar persistence reduces crowding from slower implementations

adaptation_notes: Three key adaptations from original: (1) Universe changed from NIFTY 50 constituent stocks to NIFTY index itself — the ORB mechanism is actually STRONGER on the index because it aggregates all constituent flows and is traded by larger institutional programs. (2) Hold time compressed from 20-180 min to 30-120 sec — on NIFTY, institutional ORB programs are fully automated and the first leg executes within 1-2 minutes, not 20+ minutes. We capture only the first impulse. (3) 2-bar confirmation kept at 2 bars = 10 seconds (not scaled to 2 minutes) — at 5s bars, 10 seconds of confirmation filters noise spikes effectively without sacrificing the first-mover advantage that 2 minutes would cost us. Entry window restricted to 09:30-10:30 (same as original) rather than all-day, because ORB continuation quality drops significantly after 10:30 when range reference becomes stale.
weaknesses: VIX filter (13-20) eliminates ~35% of days — on excluded days capital sits idle for this strategy
Entry restricted to 09:30-10:30 means 1-3 trades max per day; high opportunity cost from narrow window
2-bar persistence (10s) may cause entry slightly above/below the range level vs. first-touch entry, reducing R:R on winning trades
On days where NIFTY opens with a large gap, ORB levels may be so wide that 4-pt stop is too tight relative to the range

_source.original_stop: ORB_mid or 0.5 * ORB_range back inside range
